calibration.assessmentStateNote: Reaches COMPUTED_VERIFIED (rank 3), not capped at SOURCE_BOUND the way shape.button-style was: the family-cell ceiling is satisfied here because `primitive/display/card`'s own `themeControls` cell for this control now carries a non-empty `stableParts`/`propertyGroups`/`computedProperties` naming a painted delta this family DOES have -- `box-shadow` on `card-modern-md/root` measured moving, byte-identical between both ingress arms, on every receipted scenario (rottay flat/elevated, evnto flat/elevated, bithire elevated). This is the opposite finding from shape.button-style's DECLARED_CHANNEL_DOES_NOT_PAINT: here the declared channels (`--ds-elevation-1/2/3`) and the painted consequence are the SAME causal chain, not two disconnected ones -- `card.css`'s `box-shadow: var(--ds-card-shadow, var(--ds-elevation-1))` reads the declared channel directly (one hop, a documented fallback, not a rewritten sibling).

normalizedStops.law: DEFAULT/NO-OP, deliberately unreceipted where it is a no-op. `ELEVATION_PRESET.soft = {}` (appearance-posture.ts:91) -- the empty posture preset -- so absent an authored override the three channels fall through to the DS foundation seed (default.css:807 for level 1, siblings for 2/3), and writing the stop `soft` explicitly reproduces exactly that seed. Same shape as shape.button-style's `soft` stop. Measured on both arms, all three verticals, post-E-1: `soft` throws the harness's own `StopExclusionError` ("emitted none of the declared channels ... in ANY scope") on `db-tenant-theme` for every vertical -- the empty preset patches nothing, so the DB document carries no `surfaces.elevation` write to lower at all, which is a structural non-emission, not merely a non-mover. It is therefore excluded from the discrimination witness set by construction (see `stopDiscriminationException` below), the same class of exclusion as bithire's `flat` on this same arm -- not run individually, not receipted, per the same law as shape.button-style's `soft`.

calibration.identityNote: No identity stop is declared. Confirmed by exhaustive grep of all three brand-theme sources for a literal `elevation:` field: zero matches. `resolveIdentityValue` would throw fail-closed on an absent baseline value by design; an identity stop here would have to invent one, same law as shape.button-style (F4B-9).

stopDiscriminationException.reason: bithire/db-tenant-theme has only one usable witness stop, not two. `soft` is universally excluded on this arm for every vertical (see the `soft` stop law above -- the empty preset patches nothing, so there is no `surfaces.elevation` write to lower). `flat` is ADDITIONALLY excluded on bithire specifically: bithire's `experienceProfile` is `rottay/bithire-technical@1`, whose `elevation` axis is `hairline-lift`, and `ELEVATION_PROFILE_FIELDS['hairline-lift'] = 'flat'` -- the tenant's own baseline IS `flat` before any posture write, so the DB document patch for the `flat` stop is a no-op relative to that baseline and the compiler emits nothing to lower, the same `StopExclusionError` class as `soft`, not a broken door. Measured directly: `causal --stop elevated --vertical bithire` reports `db-tenant-theme lowered 1 witness stop(s)... Excluded: flat, soft`, matching this exactly. Only `elevated` survives as a witness on this arm. bithire's `static-brand-theme` arm does NOT need this exception -- measured separately (`causal --stop elevated --vertical bithire --arm static-brand-theme` and `--stop flat ... --arm static-brand-theme`): `flat` is a real, non-excluded witness there (moved=0, a genuine non-mover matching the same profile coincidence, not a structural exclusion) and `elevated` moves 6 channels, giving 2 witnesses with a discriminating pair on that arm alone.
